title: Don't Sell the Cat on Windows: install steps | Didim Labs
description: How to install the Windows version of Don't Sell the Cat bought from Didim Labs, including the Windows SmartScreen prompt and where saves are kept.

props.title: Don't Sell the Cat on Windows
props.lead: You bought the game from us and want to play on a PC. It takes about a minute.

items.title: Download
items.text: Open the Polar receipt email (or the page you saw after paying) and download `DontSellTheCat-windows-1.0.zip`, about 375 MB.

items.title: Extract
items.text: Right-click the zip, choose **Extract All**, and put the folder wherever you like.

items.title: If Windows warns you
items.text: A blue "Windows protected your PC" window can appear the first time, because the game isn't from the Microsoft Store and we don't pay for a code-signing certificate. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

props.label: Requirements
head: Needed
rows: DirectX 12 GPU. On older laptops set Graphics to Low in Settings.
`%APPDATA%\Godot\app_userdata\Don't Sell the Cat`. Copy this folder to move progress to another PC.

props.text: New versions are added to your purchase. Download the zip again from the receipt link or the Polar customer portal and replace the old folder; your saves stay where they are.
On a Mac, use [Soju](./) instead: open the Didim Labs Store tab and paste your license key.

items.title: 받기
items.text: Polar 영수증 메일(또는 결제 후 나온 페이지)에서 `DontSellTheCat-windows-1.0.zip`을 받습니다. 약 375MB입니다.

items.title: 압축 풀기
items.text: zip을 오른쪽 클릭해 **압축 풀기**를 하고 원하는 곳에 폴더를 둡니다.

items.title: 실행
items.text: 폴더 안의 `DontSellTheCat.exe`를 실행합니다. "Windows의 PC 보호" 창이 뜨면 **추가 정보** → **실행**을 누르세요. 처음 한 번만 뜹니다.

props.text: Write to [hello@didimlabs.com](mailto:hello@didimlabs.com) with your Windows version and what you see.
